verses.english: When the earth is rocked with a terrible quake
and man says, ‘What is the matter with her?’
On that day she will relate her chronicles
for her Lord will have inspired her.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًۭا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ
verses.english: On that day, mankind will issue forth in various groups to be shown their deeds.
verses.transliteration_html: Yawmaithin yasduru alnnasu ashtatan liyuraw aAAmalahum
verses.transliteration_text: Yawmaithin yasduru alnnasu ashtatan liyuraw aAAmalahum

verses.arabic: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًۭا يَرَهُۥ
verses.english: So whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it,
verses.transliteration_text: Faman yaAAmal mithqala tharratin khayran yarahu

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍۢ شَرًّۭا يَرَهُۥ
verses.english: and whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it.
verses.transliteration_text: Waman yaAAmal mithqala tharratin sharran yarahu
